cards.title: Basic Types
cards.description: TypeScript adds static types on top of JavaScript.

cards.title: Arrays & Tuples
cards.code:
let list: number[] = [1, 2, 3];
let tuple: [string, number] = ["age", 18];

cards.title: Any & Unknown
cards.code:
let a: any = 4;
let b: unknown = "hello";
cards.description: `unknown` is safer than `any` — it forces a type check before use.

cards.title: Interface
Type Alias
cards.code: type Point = { x: number; y: number };

cards.title: Union Types
cards.code: type Status = "loading" | "success" | "error";

cards.title: Extending
Typed Function
Optional & Default Params
Arrow Function Typing
cards.code: const multiply = (a: number, b: number): number => a * b;

cards.code: type PartialUser = Partial<User>;

cards.title: Pick & Omit
cards.code:
type NameOnly = Pick<User, "name">;
